doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR4: Each event displays a visual indicator (icon) above the object with a countdown timer showing time remaining. Event UX: Circular timer around the icon: A ring that slowly shrinks or a pie that fills. Visual Signalling: Icon above the object: Phone icon, kettle icon, cat icon, candle icon. Color-coded priority (subtle, not neon): Minor: soft blue, Standard: light yellow, Critical: orange/red.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Event Priority Colors: Minor Events: #64b5f6 (soft blue), Standard Events: #fff176 (light yellow), Critical Events: #ff8c42 (orange/red). Event UX: Circular timer around the icon: A ring that slowly shrinks or a pie that fills. Timer text showing seconds remaining. Visual Signalling: Icon above the object with color-coded priority.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.section: Performance Considerations, Game Event System Pattern
doc.snippet: Performance Considerations: Use CSS transforms for animations (GPU-accelerated). Avoid layout thrashing (use transform, not top/left). Timer calculations should be efficient (cache percentage if needed). Minimize re-renders (React.memo if needed, but timer updates are necessary). Game Event System Pattern: EventManager.updateEvents() called every frame in game loop. EventManager updates event.timer property (decrements by deltaTime). GameContext.activeEvents array updated (React re-renders). EventIndicator component receives updated event with new timer value.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Story 2.8 focuses on enhancing timer display with circular timer ring visualization. EventIndicator component already displays timer text (Story 2.7). This story adds circular timer ring/pie visualization. Timer ring should be visually integrated with existing icon and priority colors. Timer ring animation should be smooth and GPU-accelerated. Timer ring color should match event priority color.

doc.title: Story 2.7: Event Icons and Visual Indicators
doc.snippet: EventIndicator component already displays timer text: {Math.max(0, event.timer).toFixed(0)}s (line 116). Timer text displayed in .timer span with CSS module .timer class. Priority color classes already in CSS: Minor: #64b5f6 (soft blue) - CSS class .priorityMinor, Standard: #fff176 (light yellow) - CSS class .priorityStandard, Critical: #ff8c42 (orange/red) - CSS class .priorityCritical. Component structure is solid, needs timer ring enhancement.

doc.title: Story 2.5: Event Timer Management
doc.snippet: EventManager.updateEvents() updates all event timers every frame. Timer updates are frame-rate independent (uses deltaTime). Expired events (timer <= 0) are automatically removed. Timer values are accurate and synchronized with game loop. EventManager.updateEvents(deltaTime: number) updates all event timers every frame.

artifact.reason: Main component to enhance. Already has basic timer text display (line 116: {Math.max(0, event.timer).toFixed(0)}s). Needs circular timer ring/pie visualization. Component receives event object with timer property. Timer value updates via React re-renders when event.timer changes. Priority color classes already exist from Story 2.7.

CSS module with priority classes already defined from Story 2.7. Has .timer class with basic styling. Needs timer ring styles, animations, and priority color integration. Timer ring should use CSS conic-gradient or SVG circle for circular visualization. Animation should be GPU-accelerated (use transform, not width/height).

Manages event lifecycle and timer updates. updateEvents(deltaTime: number) updates all event timers every frame. Timer updates are frame-rate independent (uses deltaTime). Expired events (timer <= 0) are automatically removed. Provides event data with timer property that EventIndicator reads from.

Type definitions for events. GameEvent interface includes timer property (number, seconds remaining). EventType union: 'phone' | 'kettle' | 'cat' | 'candle'. EventPriority union: 'minor' | 'standard' | 'critical'. Timer property is updated by EventManager.updateEvents().

Provides activeEvents array to components. EventIndicator components read activeEvents from this context. When EventManager.updateEvents() updates timers, GameContext state updates trigger React re-renders. EventIndicators component receives updated events with new timer values.

Game loop hook that calls EventManager.updateEvents() every frame. Updates game state via GameContext. Triggers React re-renders when event timers change. Ensures timer synchronization with game loop (60 FPS).

Game constants including event scoring, coziness impact, and interaction text. Priority values defined: 'minor', 'standard', 'critical'. Event timer durations based on level. Constants match PRD specifications.

Apartment container component. Event indicators are positioned relative to this container. Provides containerRef for position calculation. Dark background (#1a1f2e) requires good visibility for timer display.

constraint.description: EventIndicator component already exists at src/components/game/EventIndicator.tsx. Component receives GameEvent object with timer property (seconds remaining). Timer value is updated by EventManager.updateEvents() every frame in game loop. Timer display should read from event.timer property (already displayed as text in Story 2.7). Component uses CSS Modules for styling (EventIndicator.module.css). Follow architecture document "Event System Pattern" section.

Timer data flow: 1. EventManager.updateEvents() called every frame in game loop, 2. EventManager updates event.timer property (decrements by deltaTime), 3. GameContext.activeEvents array updated (React re-renders), 4. EventIndicator component receives updated event with new timer value, 5. Timer display updates to show new time remaining, 6. Timer ring/pie animation reflects remaining time percentage.

Use CSS conic-gradient or SVG circle for circular timer ring. Timer ring should show remaining time as filled portion (or shrinking ring). CSS approach: Use conic-gradient with angle based on remaining time percentage. SVG approach: Use circle with stroke-dasharray/stroke-dashoffset for countdown. Animation should be smooth (60 FPS) using CSS transitions or animations. Reference UX design for timer visual style.

Timer ring color should match event priority color from Story 2.7: Minor: #64b5f6 (soft blue), Standard: #fff176 (light yellow), Critical: #ff8c42 (orange/red). Timer text color should be readable (white or light color with shadow). Priority colors already defined in CSS from Story 2.7.

Use CSS transforms for animations (GPU-accelerated). Avoid layout thrashing (use transform, not width/height changes). Timer calculations should be efficient (cache percentage if needed). Minimize re-renders (React.memo if needed, but timer updates are necessary). Reference architecture document "Performance Considerations" section.

EventIndicator integrates with GameContext (reads activeEvents). Timer reads from event.timer property (updated by EventManager). Timer display is part of EventIndicator component (enhancement of Story 2.7). Timer removal handled by GameContext state updates (same as Story 2.7). Timer synchronization already working, needs visual enhancement.

Timer ring should be visually integrated with existing icon and priority colors. Timer ring animation should be smooth and GPU-accelerated. Timer text already readable, may need minor enhancements for better visibility. Timer display should match UX design specifications for circular timer visualization.

interface.name: GameEvent Interface
interface.signature: interface GameEvent { id: string; type: EventType; priority: EventPriority; location: { x: number; y: number }; timer: number; points: number; cozinessReward: number; cozinessPenalty: number; interactionText: { en: string; uk: string }; }

interface.name: EventManager updateEvents
interface.signature: updateEvents(deltaTime: number): void - Updates all event timers every frame
